fields.headline: Ratifies a student data-sharing agreement with Teaching Strategies, LLC for early childhood education through July 2027
fields.summary: This data sharing agreement lets the district send certain student data to Teaching Strategies, LLC, which provides professional development to early childhood education teachers and needs the data for individualized coaching and evaluation. It also covers how the company must protect that data. The agreement period began July 13, 2023, before this vote, and runs through July 12, 2027. No cost is stated. The agenda text repeats the wording of the CORE Districts item (23-2233).

23-2274.note: Corrected: the agreement is with Teaching Strategies, LLC, not CORE Districts; the agenda text repeated another item's wording.
23-2274.sourceIssue: The action text names CORE Districts and a July 1, 2021 to June 30, 2024 period, repeating the text of file 23-2233, but the title and the attached agreement are with Teaching Strategies, LLC for July 13, 2023 through July 12, 2027.

23-2283.sourceIssue: The attached amendment is for a different City of Oakland grant program (Newcomer and Restorative Justice), not the ECCCO stipends the text describes. The Board repealed this item on April 10, 2024 (23-2283A) and approved the corrected amendment as 24-0845.
